label: preparing
what: A discreet gathering at the town hall for day 1 at 18:00, involving an order for 200 fresh loaves and a lighting-review appointment that brings me there. Builder has accepted personal responsibility for the outstanding 101 emeralds; baker, innkeeper and freight are coordinating bread supplies. Secretary knowingly assists with scheduling and payment coordination, though knowledge of the gathering's full purpose is uncertain. It may celebrate my forty years of service, but that purpose is speculation, not confirmed.
